attributes.title: WMHCA 2027 Conference: Bridging Connections
attributes.series: Washington Mental Health Counselors Association Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Washington Mental Health Counselors Association (ACEP No. 2079)
attributes.summary:
The Washington Mental Health Counselors Association holds its second annual conference, "Bridging Connections: Navigating Inclusive Care in an Evolving Landscape", May 13 to 15, 2027, at the Yakima Convention Center. It focuses on inclusive and culturally responsive care.

WMHCA is an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider (ACEP No. 2079). On May 11, two days before the conference, a three-hour live Zoom ethics session on the law and ethics of inclusive behavioral health care carries 3 ethics CEs. The total hours for the main conference were not published.

Registration is open but fees were not shown on the public page, and refunds are not given. Room blocks at three nearby hotels are held until April 14, 2027, under group code 0512WM.
